title: Admin Data Table Columns Response
description: Columns of one data table: the always-present standard columns first, then the table's own columns. Each column says what it holds, so a client never has to guess it from a cell's value.

id.description: data_cols.id; null for a standard column (not an editable column).

fieldKey.description: Immutable storage key. For a core form it is section_<id of the input section>.

displayName.description: Mutable human label; null when never set.

locked.description: True when the label cannot be changed by a submission: a standard column, or one an admin renamed by hand.

standard.description: True for the projection columns every row carries (record_id, entry_date, ...); read-only in the Data browser.

isFile.description: True when the column holds uploaded files: a column of a core form that belongs to a file-input section. Always false for a standard column and for tables that are not core forms.
